paragraphs.en: The rapid progress of software engineering agents drives interest in applying them to open-ended problems such as GPU kernel optimization. However, we find that existing coding agents converge to local optima on real-world, expert-written kernels (e.g., FlashInfer ). We introduce Evolving Agent Teams , a multi-agent framework that escapes such local optima. It features (1) a central supervisor that diagnoses each local optimum and restructures a team of agents; and (2) a persistent file system that comprises a learning document, an evolution history, and per-team artifacts, grounding restructuring with accumulated experience. Under a matched token budget, Evolving Agent Teams consistently outperforms strong coding-agent baselines. With an extended token budget, Evolving Agent Teams generates a CUDA kernel that reaches 1.2 × 1.2\times mean speedup over the production FlashInfer MLA paged decode kernel from scratch and wins on 36 of 47 production workloads from FlashInfer-Bench ( 0.86 0.86 – 0.99 × 0.99\times on the remaining 11). It also demonstrates superior performance on tasks such as KDA prefill on AMD MI350X ( 3.01 × 3.01\times over vLLM) and NVIDIA B200 ( 3.44 × 3.44\times over FlashKDA), MoE expert-offload serving on Apple silicon ( 30.3 30.3 tokens/s decode for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next in MLX 4-bit on a 48 GB M4 Pro), and RoboDojo robot manipulation ( 62.1 62.1 on held-out seeds vs. 55.3 55.3 for the best leaderboard entry). Code is available at https://github.com/caoshiyi/EAT .
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程智能体的快速进展推动了将其应用于 GPU 核函数优化等开放性问题。 然而，我们发现现有的编码智能体在真实世界、专家编写的核函数（例如 FlashInfer）上会收敛到局部最优。 我们提出了 Evolving Agent Teams，一个能够摆脱此类局部最优的多智能体框架。 其特点包括：(1) 一个中央监督者，用于诊断每个局部最优并重组智能体团队；(2) 一个持久化文件系统，包含学习文档、演化历史以及各团队的工作产物，以积累的经验为团队重组提供依据。 在相同的 token 预算下，Evolving Agent Teams 始终优于强大的编码智能体基线。 在扩展的 token 预算下，Evolving Agent Teams 从零开始生成了一个 CUDA 核函数，相比 FlashInfer 生产级 MLA 分页解码核函数实现了 1.2 × 1.2\times 的平均加速比，并在 FlashInfer-Bench 的 47 个生产工作负载中的 36 个上获胜（其余 11 个上为 0.86 0.86 – 0.99 × 0.99\times）。 它还在诸如 AMD MI350X 上的 KDA prefill（相比 vLLM 为 3.01 × 3.01\times）、NVIDIA B200（相比 FlashKDA 为 3.44 × 3.44\times）、Apple 芯片上的 MoE 专家卸载服务（在 48 GB M4 Pro 上以 MLX 4-bit 运行 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 时解码速度为 30.3 30.3 tokens/s）以及 RoboDojo 机器人操控（在留出种子上为 62.1 62.1，而排行榜最佳成绩为 55.3 55.3）等任务上展现出卓越性能。 代码可在 https://github.com/caoshiyi/EAT 获取。

paragraphs.en: The rapid progress of coding agents on software engineering tasks [ 15 , 42 , 38 ] has driven interest in applying them to open-ended discovery tasks such as GPU kernel optimization. Here, the goal is not just to produce a correct kernel but to search a large, hardware-dependent design space for high performance. Expert-written kernels such as FlashInfer [ 46 ] and FlashAttention [ 31 ] navigate this space across two levels: low-level primitive use (e.g., WGMMA tensor cores, swizzled shared-memory layouts) and high-level architectural design (e.g., dispatch strategies, warp specialization, dataflow). While low-level primitive use can substantially improve performance within a chosen design, high-level architectural choices often determine which hardware bottlenecks remain and thus largely shape the attainable performance ceiling.
paragraphs.zh: 编程智能体在软件工程任务上的快速进展 [ 15 , 42 , 38 ] 推动了人们将其应用于 GPU 核函数优化等开放式发现任务的兴趣。 在这里，目标不仅是生成一个正确的核函数，而是搜索一个庞大的、依赖硬件的设计空间以获得高性能。 FlashInfer [ 46 ] 和 FlashAttention [ 31 ] 等由专家编写的核函数在两个层次上驾驭这一设计空间：低层原语的使用（例如 WGMMA 张量核心、混洗的共享内存布局）和高层架构设计（例如分发策略、线程束专门化、数据流）。 虽然低层原语的使用可以在既定设计内显著提升性能，但高层架构选择往往决定了哪些硬件瓶颈依然存在，因此在很大程度上塑造了可达到的性能上限。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, even strong coding agents struggle to write challenging GPU kernels. They often make rapid initial progress, but then converge to local optima far below expert-written baselines. A common failure mode is that agents select design directions that are initially easier to implement but architecturally limited, spend most of their budget tuning within those directions, and fail to revisit harder alternatives that require substantial debugging or architectural rethinking.
paragraphs.zh: 遗憾的是，即使是强大的编码智能体也难以编写有挑战性的 GPU 内核。 它们往往在初期进展迅速，但随后收敛到远低于专家编写基准的局部最优解。 一个常见的失败模式是：智能体选择那些起初更容易实现但在架构上受限的设计方向，将大部分预算消耗在这些方向内部的调优上，而无法重新审视那些需要大量调试或架构性重新思考的更困难的备选方案。

paragraphs.en: For example, when writing the MLA decode kernel used in DeepSeek-V3 inference [ 10 ] , single-agent runs often abandoned difficult WGMMA-based implementations after repeated correctness failures, and instead optimized simpler but less efficient WMMA-based designs. These designs plateaued far below expert-written baselines: Codex 5.5 xHigh reaches only 28% of expert performance despite a $1K budget and multiple days of effort. Static agent teams show the same limitation (Section 4 ): a fixed 4-role team built with Claude Code [ 2 ] Opus 4.7 1M reaches only 55%. These results suggest that neither stronger single agents nor fixed teams are sufficient for challenging GPU kernel optimization. The process moves through distinct phases, from establishing correctness to debugging hardware primitives, profiling bottlenecks, and redesigning the kernel architecture. Each phase requires different expertise, tools, and coordination patterns, causing fixed agent organizations to become mismatched to the current stage.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，在编写用于 DeepSeek-V3 推理 [ 10 ] 的 MLA 解码内核时，单智能体运行往往在多次正确性失败后放弃基于 WGMMA 的困难实现，转而优化更简单但效率较低的基于 WMMA 的设计。 这些设计的性能远低于专家编写的基线：Codex 5.5 xHigh 即使拥有 1 千美元的预算和数天的投入，也只能达到专家性能的 28%。 静态智能体团队也表现出同样的局限（第 4 节）：使用 Claude Code [ 2 ] Opus 4.7 1M 构建的固定 4 角色团队只能达到 55%。 这些结果表明，无论是更强的单个智能体还是固定团队，都不足以应对具有挑战性的 GPU 内核优化。 这一过程会经历不同的阶段，从确立正确性到调试硬件原语、分析性能瓶颈以及重新设计内核架构。 每个阶段都需要不同的专业知识、工具和协作模式，导致固定的智能体组织与当前阶段不再匹配。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Evolving Agent Teams , a multi-agent framework that escapes such local optima by evolving the agent team’s organization alongside the optimization process. This evolution is driven by a central supervisor agent, grounded in a persistent file system with accumulated experience. Concretely, the supervisor monitors team progress, reflects on the agent behavior, diagnoses the cause of plateau (e.g., a knowledge gap or an exhausted search), and adapts the team accordingly: spawning specialists for high-effort tasks, introducing profiling roles to get more insights, or running parallel roles for different directions (Section 3.2 ). The file system contains a learning document of empirical observations, per-team artifacts, and an evolution history.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Evolving Agent Teams（演化智能体团队），这是一个多智能体框架，通过在优化过程中同步演化智能体团队的组织方式，摆脱此类局部最优。 这一演化由一个中央监督者智能体驱动，并依托一个积累了经验的持久化文件系统。 具体而言，监督者监控团队进展，反思智能体的行为，诊断停滞的原因（例如知识缺口或搜索空间耗尽），并相应地调整团队：为高成本任务生成专家角色，引入分析角色以获取更多洞察，或针对不同方向并行运行多个角色（见第 3.2 节）。 该文件系统包含一份记录经验性观察的学习文档、每个团队的产物以及一份演化历史。

paragraphs.en: On the MLA decode kernel, Evolving Agent Teams explores over 100 team configurations. The supervisor repeatedly reconfigures the team around the current failure mode, which improves token efficiency and enables successive architectural advances, including performant WGMMA-based matrix multiplication, a PV accumulation strategy, and L2 prefetching. Together, these improvements allow Evolving Agent Teams to substantially outperform prior single-agent and static-team approaches (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 MLA 解码内核上，Evolving Agent Teams 探索了超过 100 种团队配置。 监督者围绕当前的失败模式反复重新配置智能体团队，这提高了 token 效率，并实现了连续的架构进展，包括高性能的基于 WGMMA 的矩阵乘法、一种 PV 累加策略以及 L2 预取。 这些改进共同使 Evolving Agent Teams 的性能大幅超越之前的单智能体和静态团队方法（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on four challenging CUDA kernel optimization tasks spanning two GPU architectures (Section 4 ): Flash Attention 4 [ 49 ] and Gated Delta Net [ 43 ] prefill on Blackwell B200, and MLA paged decode [ 10 , 46 ] and fused GEMM+AllReduce (G+AR) [ 35 ] on Hopper H100. Evolving Agent Teams outperforms strong coding agent baselines on every task. Notably, on the MLA paged decode task, evaluated on 47 production DeepSeek-V3 workloads from FlashInfer-Bench [ 11 ] , Claude Code agent plateaus at 0.51 × 0.51\times the expert-written FlashInfer kernel, while our system reaches 0.74 × 0.74\times under a matched token budget. With additional budget, the system surpasses the production FlashInfer baseline, achieving 1.21 × 1.21\times mean speedup , faster on 36 of 47 workloads, while the previous best result is 0.61 × 0.61\times from K-Search [ 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在四个具有挑战性的 CUDA 内核优化任务上进行评估，涵盖两种 GPU 架构（第 4 节）：Blackwell B200 上的 Flash Attention 4 [49] 和 Gated Delta Net [43] 预填充，以及 Hopper H100 上的 MLA 分页解码 [10, 46] 和融合 GEMM+AllReduce（G+AR）[35]。 演化智能体团队在每个任务上都优于强大的编码智能体基线。 值得注意的是，在 MLA 分页解码任务上，基于来自 FlashInfer-Bench [11] 的 47 个生产级 DeepSeek-V3 工作负载进行评估，Claude Code 智能体停留在专家编写的 FlashInfer 内核的 0.51 × 0.51\times 倍水平，而在匹配的 token 预算下，我们的系统达到了 0.74 × 0.74\times 倍。 在追加预算后，该系统超越了生产级 FlashInfer 基线，实现了 1.21 × 1.21\times 倍的平均加速，在 47 个工作负载中的 36 个上更快，而此前最好的结果是来自 K-Search [5] 的 0.61 × 0.61\times 倍。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent LLM systems. ChatDev [ 29 ] , MetaGPT [ 13 ] , and MAGIS [ 36 ] assign fixed roles (programmer, reviewer, tester) to distinct agents for software engineering. AutoGen [ 40 ] provides a general multi-agent conversation framework; DyLAN [ 22 ] and AgentVerse [ 9 ] dynamically adapt the team’s role composition during execution, but either select from a hand-crafted pool of role prompts ( DyLAN ) or regenerate the group from scratch each round without preserving global context across re-compositions ( AgentVerse ). Our framework differs in two respects: (1) it operates over multi-day horizons where the nature of productive work changes qualitatively (from knowledge acquisition to search to verification), requiring changes to agent roles and mandates , not merely routing; and (2) the supervisor maintains a persistent global file system across team restructurings.

paragraphs.en: Self-improving agents and evolutionary search. Reflexion [ 33 ] accumulates verbal feedback across trials; Voyager [ 37 ] builds a growing skill library. These approaches improve a single agent’s behavior within a fixed role, whereas our framework adapts the broader optimization process around a single agent. FunSearch [ 30 ] , OpenEvolve [ 32 ] and AlphaEvolve [ 24 ] use population-based evolutionary search with LLM-driven mutation over programs. Our approach differs in that it employs no population and no crossover; instead, a supervisor performs sequential, diagnosis-driven adaptation of the agent team architecture. ADAS [ 14 ] uses an LLM with an archive to iteratively propose new agent architectures. Our work also uses an LLM to iteratively adapt the team architecture. However, the purpose of this adaptation is different: rather than searching for a standalone best agent architecture, we evolve the team to better facilitate the optimization process at different stages.
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进的智能体与进化搜索。 Reflexion [ 33 ] 在多次尝试间累积语言反馈；Voyager [ 37 ] 构建一个不断增长的技能库。 这些方法在固定角色内改进单个智能体的行为，而我们的框架则围绕单个智能体调整更广泛的优化过程。 FunSearch [ 30 ]、OpenEvolve [ 32 ] 和 AlphaEvolve [ 24 ] 使用基于种群的进化搜索，并以大语言模型驱动的变异作用于程序。 我们的方法不同之处在于它不使用种群，也不使用交叉；而是由一个监督者对智能体团队架构进行顺序的、基于诊断的调整。 ADAS [ 14 ] 使用一个大语言模型和存档来迭代地提出新的智能体架构。 我们的工作同样使用大语言模型来迭代地调整团队架构。 然而，这种调整的目的有所不同：我们并非搜索一个独立最优的智能体架构，而是演化团队，以便在不同阶段更好地促进优化过程。

paragraphs.en: Meta-optimization and text optimization. A growing body of work uses LLMs to optimize text and code artifacts iteratively. OPRO [ 41 ] optimizes prompts conditioned on past (solution, score) pairs; TextGrad [ 48 ] provides textual feedback on current artifacts; GEPA [ 1 ] uses reflective feedback from rollout traces. Meta-Harness [ 19 ] optimizes the code surrounding a fixed LLM by giving a coding-agent proposer full filesystem access to prior candidates’ source code, scores, and execution traces. Our work shares the insight that richer access to prior experience enables better meta-optimization. However, the object of optimization is different: Meta-Harness optimizes the surrounding harness, whereas our method adapts the search process itself to better discover high-performance kernel implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 元优化与文本优化。 越来越多的工作利用大语言模型迭代地优化文本和代码产物。 OPRO [41] 基于过去的（解，得分）对来优化提示词；TextGrad [48] 针对当前产物提供文本反馈；GEPA [1] 利用来自执行轨迹的反思性反馈。 Meta-Harness [19] 通过赋予一个编码智能体提议者对先前候选方案的源代码、得分和执行轨迹的完整文件系统访问权限，来优化固定大语言模型周围的代码。 我们的工作与此共享一个洞见：对先前经验的更充分访问能够实现更好的元优化。 然而，优化的对象不同：Meta-Harness 优化的是外围框架，而我们的方法则调整搜索过程本身，以更好地发现高性能的核函数实现。

paragraphs.en: Code generation and optimization, and inference-time scaling. SWE-agent [ 42 ] , SkyRL-Agent [ 4 ] and SWE-Gym [ 27 ] advance agents in software engineering tasks. In GPU kernel optimization, most of the existing LLM-based solutions [ 39 , 18 , 21 , 50 ] adopt a fixed human-designed system, where LLMs refine kernels based on compilation or profiling feedback. Some recent works [ 12 ] add evolutionary strategies into the system for maintaining and selecting candidates. K-Search [ 5 ] decouples planning from implementation via a co-evolving world model but employs a fixed two-role configuration. Inference-time compute scaling [ 34 , 20 ] improves reasoning within a fixed inference-time search procedure; our framework addresses the complementary problem of adapting the search process itself.
paragraphs.zh: 代码生成与优化，以及推理时扩展。 SWE-agent [42]、SkyRL-Agent [4] 和 SWE-Gym [27] 推动了智能体在软件工程任务中的发展。 在 GPU 内核优化方面，现有的基于大语言模型的解决方案 [39, 18, 21, 50] 大多采用固定的人类设计系统，即由大语言模型根据编译或性能剖析反馈来改进内核。 一些近期工作 [12] 在系统中引入进化策略，用于维护和选择候选解。 K-Search [5] 通过共同演化的世界模型将规划与实现解耦，但采用固定的双角色配置。 推理时计算扩展 [34, 20] 在固定的推理时搜索过程中提升推理能力；而我们的框架解决的是一个互补的问题，即对搜索过程本身进行自适应调整。

paragraphs.en: Existing LLM-based systems tackling this problem [ 42 , 3 , 29 , 13 , 30 , 24 , 7 ] can be characterized by an agent team configuration T = ( R , Π , M ) T=(R,\Pi,M) governing three design choices:
paragraphs.zh: 现有的解决该问题的基于 LLM 的系统 [ 42 , 3 , 29 , 13 , 30 , 24 , 7 ] 可以通过一个智能体团队配置 T = ( R , Π , M ) T=(R,\Pi,M) 来刻画，该配置决定了三个设计选择：

paragraphs.en: Roles R R — what each agent is responsible for, e.g., a single generalist [ 42 , 26 , 2 ] , fixed programmer/reviewer/tester [ 29 , 13 ] , or an LLM mutation operator [ 30 , 24 , 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Roles R R — 每个智能体负责什么，例如，单个通才智能体 [ 42 , 26 , 2 ] 、固定的程序员/审阅者/测试者 [ 29 , 13 ] ，或 LLM 变异算子 [ 30 , 24 , 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Coordination Π \Pi — how agents interact, e.g., no coordination (single agent), a fixed role-to-role pipeline [ 29 , 13 ] , or a select-mutate-evaluate cycle [ 30 , 24 , 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 协调方式 Π \Pi — 即智能体之间如何交互，例如无协调（单一智能体）、固定的角色到角色流水线 [ 29 , 13 ] ，或选择-变异-评估循环 [ 30 , 24 , 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge management M M — how experience is accumulated and shared, e.g., the filesystem with no explicit management [ 42 , 2 ] , structured message passing enforced by fixed protocol [ 29 , 13 ] , or a candidate archive [ 30 , 24 , 32 , 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 知识管理 M M —— 经验如何被积累与共享，例如没有显式管理的文件系统 [ 42 , 2 ] 、由固定协议强制的结构化消息传递 [ 29 , 13 ] ，或候选档案库 [ 30 , 24 , 32 , 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In most existing frameworks, all three are human-designed and fixed before the run begins. 1 1 1 Some evolutionary systems adapt search hyperparameters during a run (e.g., AdaEvolve [ 7 ] modulates exploration intensity and budget allocation); here “fixed” refers specifically to the team configuration T = ( R , Π , M ) T=(R,\Pi,M) , the roles, coordination protocol, and knowledge management strategy, which remain static in all listed systems. These systems optimize the solution s s but do not adapt T T itself, making them prone to stagnation at local optima during long-running open-ended optimization tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在大多数现有框架中，这三者均由人类预先设计，并在运行开始之前即已固定。1 1 1 一些演化系统会在运行过程中自适应搜索超参数（例如，AdaEvolve [7] 会调节探索强度与预算分配）；此处的「固定」特指团队配置 T = ( R , Π , M ) T=(R,\Pi,M) ，即角色、协调协议与知识管理策略，它们在所有列举的系统中均保持静态。 这些系统只对解 s s 进行优化，而不对 T T 本身进行自适应调整，因此在长时间运行的开放式优化任务中容易停滞于局部最优。

It operates at two levels, following the loop shown in Figure 2 : at the team evolution level, a supervisor agent monitors each team’s execution, analyzes success and failure patterns, and designs the next team T v + 1 T_{v+1} . paragraphs.en: Roles. The supervisor invents roles as needed, rather than selecting from a predefined set. A single agent handling implementation, profiling, and research simultaneously divides its limited context across all three, sacrificing depth in each. The supervisor addresses this by creating focused roles such as Profiling Scientist (designs targeted microbenchmarks to isolate bottlenecks), Challenger (stress-tests claimed performance ceilings), Primitive Study Agent (studies potentially useful primitives and their usage, running small tests), and Knowledge Integrator (synthesizes findings scattered across prior teams into actionable plans). Table 3 in the appendix lists other observed roles.
paragraphs.zh: 角色。 主管（supervisor）根据需要创设角色，而不是从预定义的角色集合中选择。 一个智能体同时处理实现、性能剖析和研究，会将其有限的上下文分散到这三项任务上，从而牺牲每项任务的深度。 主管通过创建专注的角色来解决这一问题，例如剖析科学家（Profiling Scientist，设计有针对性的微基准测试来隔离瓶颈）、挑战者（Challenger，对声称的性能上限进行压力测试）、原语研究智能体（Primitive Study Agent，研究可能有用的原语及其用法并运行小型测试）和知识整合者（Knowledge Integrator，将分散在先前各团队中的发现综合为可执行的计划）。 附录中的表 3 列出了其他观察到的角色。

paragraphs.en: Coordination. The supervisor decides how agents interact: it can pipeline them (research → \to implement → \to profile), run them in parallel on separate branches, or combine both. For example, the supervisor may spawn one agent solely to debug a blocking issue (forbidden from touching the main codebase) while a second agent continues optimizations on the main branch, so that one agent’s failure does not block the other’s progress.
paragraphs.zh: 协调。 主管决定各智能体之间如何交互：它可以将它们串联起来（研究 → \to 实现 → \to 分析画像）、让它们在独立分支上并行运行，或将两者结合。 例如，主管可以专门生成一个智能体来调试某个阻塞问题（禁止其改动主代码库），同时让第二个智能体继续在主分支上进行优化，这样一个智能体的失败就不会阻碍另一个智能体的进展。

paragraphs.en: Tasks. We evaluate on four GPU kernel optimization tasks spanning two architectures (Table 1 ). FA4 targets the attention forward pass [ 49 ] , written in CuTe DSL [ 6 ] ; the challenge is co-designing algorithm and kernel pipelining for Blackwell’s asymmetric hardware scaling, where tensor core throughput doubles but shared memory bandwidth and non-matmul units do not. GDN computes a prefill pass for Gated DeltaNet [ 43 ] , a linear RNN with a matrix-valued hidden state; the challenge is parallelizing the inherently sequential recurrence over long sequences via a chunkwise algorithm. MLA implements paged decode for DeepSeek-V3’s Multi-head Latent Attention [ 10 ] ; the challenge is overlapping CUDA core and tensor core work efficiently under extreme register pressure due to MLA’s large head dimension. G+AR fuses GEMM with inter-GPU AllReduce into a single kernel, overlapping computation and communication; efficient fusing requires writing a custom WGMMA GEMM kernel with tile-level scheduling to overlap reduction with compute.
paragraphs.zh: 任务。 我们在两个架构上共四个 GPU 核函数优化任务上进行评估（表 1）。 FA4 针对注意力前向传播 [49]，使用 CuTe DSL [6] 编写；其挑战在于为 Blackwell 的非对称硬件扩展协同设计算法与核函数流水线——张量核吞吐量翻倍，但共享内存带宽和非矩阵乘单元并未翻倍。 GDN 计算 Gated DeltaNet [43] 的预填充（prefill）过程，这是一种具有矩阵值隐藏状态的线性 RNN；其挑战在于通过分块（chunkwise）算法将本质上顺序的递归在长序列上并行化。 MLA 为 DeepSeek-V3 的多头潜在注意力（Multi-head Latent Attention）[10] 实现分页解码（paged decode）；其挑战在于在 MLA 较大的头维度带来的极端寄存器压力下，高效地重叠 CUDA 核与张量核的工作。 G+AR 将 GEMM 与 GPU 间 AllReduce 融合到单个核函数中，重叠计算与通信；高效融合需要编写带有 tile 级调度的自定义 WGMMA GEMM 核函数，以便将规约与计算重叠。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare against three baseline systems. (1) Claude Code [ 2 ] : Claude Code powered by Claude Opus 4.6 with 1M context window, a state-of-the-art coding agent with file editing, shell access, and compiler invocation that autonomously writes, compiles, profiles, and iterates on kernel code. It receives the same task description, reference kernel, and test harness as the evolving team. Evaluated on all four tasks in the budget-controlled experiment (Section 4.2 ). (2) Fixed four-role team : a static team of four common high-value roles for GPU kernel optimization (Profiler, Hardware Researcher, Planner, Implementer), each powered by Claude Code with the same Opus 4.7 1M model, but with no supervisor and no team restructuring. Evaluated on MLA in the ablation study (Section 4.5 ). (3) Codex [ 26 ] : a strong coding agent powered by GPT-5.5 xhigh with 258K context. Evaluated on MLA in the ablation study (Section 4.5 ). (4) Kernel-specific systems : K-Search [ 5 ] and CUDAForge [ 50 ] , run from their publicly released implementations with Claude Opus 4.6. Evaluated on MLA (Section 4.6 ). For Claude Code, K-Search , CUDAForge , and Evolving Agent Teams , we run each setting twice and report the best result; the fixed-team and Codex ablations are single runs.

paragraphs.en: The GDN prefill panel shows particularly high speedups ( > 2 × >2\times ) because the 100-workload benchmark includes many small input sizes where FlashInfer’s planning and preprocessing overhead dominates end-to-end latency, even with plan() cached across calls. Our generated kernel requires no planning stage, so on these small workloads it achieves disproportionately large speedups. Under the budget-controlled setting, the best Evolving Agent Teams run has a worst workload of 0.19 × 0.19\times with 43 of 100 below the baseline, compared to 0.13 × 0.13\times and 49 of 100 for the best Claude Code run. With additional budget (Section 4.3 ), the worst workload improves to 0.40 × 0.40\times with 37 of 100 below the baseline.
paragraphs.zh: GDN prefill 面板显示出特别高的加速比（>2×），因为 100 个工作负载的基准测试包含许多小输入规模，即使 plan() 在多次调用间被缓存，FlashInfer 的规划与预处理开销仍主导端到端延迟。 我们生成的内核无需规划阶段，因此在这些小工作负载上取得了不成比例的大幅加速。 在预算受控的设置下，表现最好的 Evolving Agent Teams 运行的最差工作负载为 0.19×，100 个中有 43 个低于基线；相比之下，表现最好的 Claude Code 运行为 0.13×，100 个中有 49 个低于基线。 在追加预算后（第 4.3 节），最差工作负载提升至 0.40×，100 个中有 37 个低于基线。

paragraphs.en: On GEMM+AllReduce, the single-agent run produces a cuBLAS-based kernel, yielding a mean speedup of 1.08 × 1.08\times compared to the cuBLAS + NCCL baseline. The budget-controlled evolving team similarly converges on a cuBLAS+NCCL pipeline, achieving 1.18 × 1.18\times with stronger gains at larger matrix sizes (32K: 1.34 × 1.34\times ). With additional budget (Section 4.3 ), the team discovers a fused WGMMA+NVLS kernel that bypasses cuBLAS entirely and leverages NVLink multicast for the all-reduce, reaching 1.49 × 1.49\times overall and 2.57 × 2.57\times on the smallest workload where communication latency dominates.
paragraphs.zh: 在 GEMM+AllReduce 任务上，单智能体运行生成了基于 cuBLAS 的内核，相比 cuBLAS + NCCL 基线取得了 1.08 × 1.08\times 的平均加速比。 预算受控的演化团队同样收敛到 cuBLAS+NCCL 流水线，取得 1.18 × 1.18\times 的加速，且在更大矩阵规模下收益更强（32K：1.34 × 1.34\times）。 在额外预算下（第 4.3 节），团队发现了一个融合的 WGMMA+NVLS 内核，完全绕开 cuBLAS，并利用 NVLink 多播执行 all-reduce，整体达到 1.49 × 1.49\times，在通信延迟占主导的最小工作负载上达到 2.57 × 2.57\times。

paragraphs.en: G+AR (Figure 4(b) ) reaches 1.56 × 1.56\times over the cuBLAS+NCCL baseline, comparable to ThunderKittens [ 35 ] , which is at 1.54 × 1.54\times over cuBLAS+NCCL. The trajectory illustrates three distinct phases that require qualitatively different capabilities. Versions 1–5 focus on correctness: the team debugs WGMMA register layouts and IPC cache coherence for multi-GPU communication, producing a working but slow two-phase kernel ( 0.54 × 0.54\times ). paragraphs.en: The four tasks above start from naïve reference kernels. To test whether Evolving Agent Teams can also improve code that has already been carefully optimized by domain experts, we apply it to Flash-KMeans [ 45 ] , a recent GPU-optimized exact K-Means implementation. The released implementation uses hand-tuned Triton kernels. We task the Evolving Agent Teams with rewriting the assignment kernel in CUDA, starting from the Triton source as a reference rather than a naïve PyTorch baseline. As shown in Figure 5 , the system produces a CUDA WGMMA kernel that reaches 1.71 × 1.71\times speedup over the Triton kernel on the default workload, and achieves up to 1.5 × 1.5\times lower latency on compute-bound configurations (high K K ) across the full benchmark grid (Figure 5(b) ).

paragraphs.en: We further compare against two systems designed specifically for GPU kernel optimization, K-Search [ 5 ] and CUDAForge [ 50 ] , on MLA decode. All systems use Claude Opus 4.6 with medium thinking effort and the same $800 model-inference budget, and each is run twice. paragraphs.en: Strong coding agents make rapid initial progress on GPU kernel optimization but converge to local optima well below expert-written baselines. Evolving Agent Teams escapes these local optima by evolving the team’s organization alongside the search: a central supervisor diagnoses each plateau and restructures the team’s roles, grounded in a persistent file system. Across four CUDA kernel optimization tasks on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs, it consistently outperforms strong coding-agent baselines under a matched token budget, and with additional budget it surpasses the production FlashInfer MLA decode kernel at 1.21 × 1.21\times mean speedup across 47 workloads. It also demonstrates superior performance on tasks such as KDA prefill on AMD and NVIDIA GPUs, MoE expert-offload serving on Apple silicon, and robot manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 强大的编码智能体在 GPU 核函数优化上能快速取得初始进展，但会收敛到远低于专家手写基线的局部最优。 演化智能体团队通过让团队组织与搜索一同演化来摆脱这些局部最优：一个中央监督者诊断每个停滞期并重构团队的角色分工，这一切基于一个持久化的文件系统。 在 Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 上的四项 CUDA 核函数优化任务中，在相同的 token 预算下它持续超越强大的编码智能体基线；而在追加预算后，它以 1.21 × 1.21\times 的平均加速比在 47 个工作负载上超越了生产级的 FlashInfer MLA 解码核函数。 它还在诸如 AMD 和 NVIDIA GPU 上的 KDA 预填充、Apple 芯片上的 MoE 专家卸载推理服务以及机器人操作等任务上展现出卓越性能。

paragraphs.en: The failure is structural rather than capability-driven. Each role’s charter implicitly scopes its outputs (the Hardware Researcher operates as a recipe expert, not an auditor); spawn prompts specify reactive behavior, locking roles into question-and-answer loops that preclude proactive code inspection; and the SendMessage primitive carries prose, encouraging abstract agreement (“ LBO=16 , confirm?”) over byte-level cross-checking. Fixed-role multi-agent systems can therefore stall on debugging tasks that cross role boundaries. Evolving Agent Teams addresses this class of failure: the supervisor diagnoses the stall as a knowledge gap and introduces a Knowledge Integrator (Section 3.3 ) that mandates cross-agent artifact reads.
paragraphs.zh: 这一失败是结构性的，而非能力所致。 每个角色的章程隐式限定了其输出范围（硬件研究员作为配方专家运作，而非审计者）；生成提示规定了被动响应行为，将角色锁定在问答循环中，无法进行主动的代码检查；并且 SendMessage 原语传递的是文本，助长了抽象的认同（「LBO=16，确认吗？」），而非字节级的交叉核对。 因此，固定角色的多智能体系统在跨越角色边界的调试任务上可能陷入停滞。 进化式智能体团队解决了这一类失败：监督者将停滞诊断为知识缺口，并引入知识整合者（第 3.3 节），强制要求跨智能体地阅读产出物。

paragraphs.en: KDA prefill on AMD MI350X. Kimi Delta Attention [ 16 ] is a gated delta rule with a per-key-channel forget gate and a matrix-valued fp32 state; the kernel computes the chunked prefill from the raw projections (normalization, gates and recurrence). The task uses one MI350X (CDNA4) and the tensor-parallel shape of a production deployment ( H = 12 H{=}12 heads per GPU, K = V = 128 K{=}V{=}128 ). The baseline is vLLM’s hand-written fused HIP prefill kernels used in production [ 17 ] ; the starting kernel is a port of them (score 0.99 0.99 ). The score is the arithmetic mean of baseline-over-candidate latency across 10 variable-length workloads (single sequences of 1K–64K tokens, batches from 4 × 4 4{\times}4 K to 64 × 128 64{\times}128 , and one mixed batch), with the cache flushed before each timed run. Correctness requires relative L 2 L_{2} error ≤ 2 × 10 − 2 \leq 2{\times}10^{-2} on outputs and final states; the team itself found that the evaluation’s fast-decaying gates let state-handoff bugs pass, and added a slow-decay check that every subsequent kernel had to pass, along with a held-out shape set that is checked but not scored. The run used Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort) for all agents, lasted 73 iterations (186 hours), and booked $3.0K. The final kernel scores 3.01 × 3.01\times (mean of five re-measurements; per-workload 2.09 2.09 – 4.63 × 4.63\times ) and is 7.3 × 7.3\times faster than the Triton kernel from Flash Linear Attention. Its main structural changes are a “relay” that fuses the prologue with the recurrence and passes the state between workgroups through the shared L2 cache, bf16/fp16 state handoffs and non-temporal loads, fp16 matrix operands ( + 5.5 % +5.5\% and more accurate than bf16), and a “twin route” that feeds one 64-token recurrence step from two 32-token prologues.
paragraphs.zh: KDA 在 AMD MI350X 上的预填充（prefill）。 Kimi Delta Attention [16] 是一种带门控的 delta 规则，具有逐键通道遗忘门和矩阵形式的 fp32 状态；该内核从原始投影（归一化、门控和递推）直接计算分块预填充。 该任务使用一块 MI350X（CDNA4），张量并行形状与生产部署一致（每块 GPU H{=}12 个注意力头，K{=}V{=}128）。 基线是 vLLM 生产环境中使用的手写融合 HIP 预填充内核 [17]；起始内核是它们的一个移植版本（得分 0.99）。 得分是基线相对候选实现的延迟比在 10 个变长工作负载（1K–64K token 的单序列、从 4{\times}4K 到 64{\times}128 的批次，以及一个混合批次）上的算术平均值，每次计时运行前都会清空缓存。 正确性要求输出和最终状态的相对 L_{2} 误差 \leq 2{\times}10^{-2}；团队自己发现评估中快速衰减的门控会让状态传递的缺陷漏过，因此增加了一个慢衰减检查，要求后续每个内核都必须通过，同时还加入了一组被校验但不计分的保留形状集合。 本次运行对所有智能体使用 Claude Opus 5.5（中等投入），共进行 73 次迭代（186 小时），花费 3.0K 美元。 最终内核得分 3.01×（五次重测的均值；各工作负载为 2.09–4.63×），比 Flash Linear Attention 的 Triton 内核快 7.3×。 其主要结构性改动包括：一个将前奏（prologue）与递推融合并通过共享 L2 缓存在工作组之间传递状态的「接力」（relay）；bf16/fp16 状态交接和非临时加载；fp16 矩阵操作数（+5.5\%，且比 bf16 更精确）；以及一个由两个 32-token 前奏馈送一个 64-token 递推步骤的「双路由」（twin route）。

paragraphs.en: KDA prefill on B200. The task is the same operator on B200 ( sm_100a ), scored as the geomean speedup over FlashKDA [ 23 ] , a fused CUTLASS implementation, in a clean room with no web access. The team could read FlashKDA, the Triton KDA kernels of Flash Linear Attention, the CUTLASS/CuTe examples, FlashAttention-4 [ 49 ] , and a read-only snapshot of FlashInfer [ 46 ] at commit a9e03bf2 (Aug. 13, 2026), which includes the SM100 KDA prefill kernels that CAKE [ 47 ] contributed to FlashInfer ; the team ported these in the first iteration ( 1.96 × 1.96\times ). The score covers six workloads (8,192 tokens, H ∈ { 64 , 96 } H\in\{64,96\} , fixed and variable-length layouts). Iterations 1–5 used Claude Opus 5.5 and later iterations Claude Sonnet 5.5. Comparison with KDA 2 . KDA 2 [ 51 ] reports 2.96 × 2.96\times over FlashKDA on B300 on the same six workloads. We recompiled the team’s final kernel for B300 ( sm_103a , no code change) and scored it and KDA 2 ’s released kernels with the same harness on the same B300: 3.54 × 3.54\times for ours, against 3.02 × 3.02\times (TIRx), 2.98 × 2.98\times (PTX), and 2.85 × 2.85\times (CuTe-DSL) for KDA 2 . On B200, the same harness gives 3.44 × 3.44\times , against 2.91 × 2.91\times (TIRx) and 2.74 × 2.74\times (CuTe-DSL); the PTX kernels run only on B300. Because the run starts from a port of an existing kernel, it measures improvement over a strong start rather than from scratch.

paragraphs.en: MoE expert-offload serving on Apple silicon. The task is to make a Metal port of the FreeToken MoE serving system [ 44 ] serve Qwen3.8-Flash-Next at 4 bits (about 79 GB of weights plus a 32 GB per-layer embedding table; 512 routed experts per layer, top-10 plus a shared expert) as fast as possible on a 48 GB M4 Pro Mac, streaming experts that do not fit in memory from SSD through an offload cache. The model and math must stay the same: no expert skipping or pruning, no lower top- k k , no fewer bits. Gates check top-1 agreement with the naive engine’s greedy predictions, KL divergence, peak memory ( ≤ 37 \leq 37 GiB), swap growth, and load time, and a candidate that fails any gate scores 0. The score is the mean over workload terms of baseline time over candidate time; the workload replays sessions recorded from a real coding-agent loop, teacher-forced from a cold page cache, plus a batch-1 decode benchmark. All agents used Claude Opus 5.5, with web search and fetch tools disabled. The supervisor resized the team from one agent to three and finally to two, and re-cut its roles six times: by file type (I/O vs. compute), by bottleneck (speculation, cache, offload), by time slice (decode vs. prefill), and by measured gap (GPU time per token). Main changes include a victim cache for evicted experts, compact GPU expert slots with shared palette indices, (scale, bias) palette compression that cuts expert reads by 7%, and admission rather than eviction as the residency lever, after a cache role found that most decode misses had already been read during the preceding prefill. The final engine decodes at 27.3 27.3 tokens/s on the batch-1 decode benchmark, against 13.4 13.4 for the naive engine. In Figure 7 c, iterations 3–6 have no valid evaluation, and each iteration’s cost is its team cost scaled so that the total matches the booked $1.0K, which includes the supervisor.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Apple 芯片上的 MoE 专家卸载推理服务。 任务是把 FreeToken MoE 推理服务系统 [ 44 ] 移植到 Metal，并在 48 GB M4 Pro Mac 上以 4 比特（约 79 GB 权重外加 32 GB 逐层嵌入表；每层 512 个路由专家，top-10 加一个共享专家）尽可能快地服务 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，把放不进内存的专家通过卸载缓存从 SSD 流式读入。 模型和数学必须保持不变：不跳过或剪枝专家，不降低 top-k，不减少比特数。 各项门槛检查与朴素引擎的贪心预测的 top-1 一致性、KL 散度、峰值内存（≤ 37 GiB）、换页增长和加载时间，任何一项未通过的候选方案得 0 分。 得分是各工作负载项上基线时间除以候选时间的均值；工作负载回放从真实编码智能体循环中录制的会话，在冷页缓存下以教师强制方式运行，外加一个 batch-1 解码基准。 所有智能体均使用 Claude Opus 5.5，并禁用网络搜索和抓取工具。 主管把团队规模从一个智能体调整到三个、最后调整为两个，并六次重新划分角色：按文件类型（I/O 与计算）、按瓶颈（投机、缓存、卸载）、按时间段（解码与预填充）、按实测差距（每 token 的 GPU 时间）。 主要改动包括：为被驱逐的专家设置 victim cache、带共享调色板索引的紧凑 GPU 专家槽位、将专家读取量削减 7% 的 (scale, bias) 调色板压缩，以及在发现大多数解码未命中其实已在先前预填充阶段被读取过之后，把常驻控制手段从驱逐改为准入。 最终引擎在 batch-1 解码基准上达到 27.3 token/s，而朴素引擎为 13.4。 在图 7c 中，第 3–6 次迭代没有有效评估，每次迭代的成本是其团队成本按比例缩放后的结果，使总成本与记账的 1.0 千美元（含主管）相符。

paragraphs.en: RoboDojo. RoboDojo [ 8 ] has 42 dual-arm manipulation tasks in Isaac Sim, grouped into five dimensions (generalization, memory, precision, long-horizon, open-ended); the leaderboard score is the mean of the five dimension means of per-task partial-credit scores (0–100). The team edits a Python controller package with per-task skill modules. At run time the policy may call the frozen π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} checkpoint [ 28 ] and a runtime LLM (Claude, at most 20 calls per episode); inputs are three RGB cameras, joint states, and the instruction, and no model training is allowed. The agents’ outbound network is limited to the Anthropic API and the evaluation fleet, and other leaderboard entries’ policy code is removed from the hosts. Agents develop on seed 1; seeds 0 and 2 are held out and evaluated only by the operator, and agents never see those scores. Iterations 1–36 optimize a 10-task subset; iterations 37–51 use all 42 tasks. The supervisor and all agents used Claude Sonnet 5.5, and the run booked $472 through iteration 50 (excluding runtime-LLM calls). The iteration-50 policy scores 62.1 62.1 held-out (50 episodes per task on each held-out seed) and 62.6 62.6 on dev.

paragraphs.en: MoE expert-offload serving, from an optimized start. A second run starts both the team and a solo agent from the final engine of the run in Appendix C (about 3.2 × 3.2\times naive), each on two identical Macs, both shown a $1,000 budget, and both stopped at the same 20-hour deadline. Table 4 reports all versions re-measured afterwards in the same batch on the same machines, on the dev workload and on two held-out workloads: (A) a long prefix-reuse session and (B) four real Claude Code sessions. At $200 the team and the solo agent are close; the solo agent leads on the workload it optimized and the team on both held-out workloads. The solo agent’s later changes are mostly small parameter tweaks (e.g., the half-life of the expert-cache eviction policy), which help the dev workload more than the held-out ones. The solo agent progressed more slowly and spent $200 in the 20 hours, while the team kept improving through $509 (decode lookahead hints, then exact multi-row verification enabling speculative decoding, then a larger victim cache), and its final engine is the fastest on every workload. Measured together on the same Macs, it decodes at 30.3 30.3 tokens/s on the batch-1 decode benchmark, against 26.7 26.7 for the starting commit and 28.2 28.2 for the solo agent’s final engine.

sents.en: A second run starts both the team and a solo agent from the final engine of the run in Appendix C (about 3.2 × 3.2\times naive), each on two identical Macs, both shown a $1,000 budget, and both stopped at the same 20-hour deadline.
sents.zh: 第二轮运行从附录 C 中该轮运行的最终引擎（约为朴素实现的 3.2 倍性能）出发，同时启动团队和一个单独的智能体，两者各使用两台相同的 Mac，都被给予 1,000 美元预算，并在相同的 20 小时期限处停止。

sents.en: Table 4 reports all versions re-measured afterwards in the same batch on the same machines, on the dev workload and on two held-out workloads: (A) a long prefix-reuse session and (B) four real Claude Code sessions.
sents.zh: 表 4 报告了随后在同一批次中、在相同机器上重新测量的所有版本，涵盖开发工作负载以及两个留出工作负载：（A）一个长前缀复用会话，以及（B）四个真实的 Claude Code 会话。

sents.en: At $200 the team and the solo agent are close; the solo agent leads on the workload it optimized and the team on both held-out workloads.
sents.zh: 在 200 美元时团队与单独的智能体接近；单独的智能体在其所优化的工作负载上领先，而团队在两个留出工作负载上领先。

sents.en: The solo agent’s later changes are mostly small parameter tweaks (e.g., the half-life of the expert-cache eviction policy), which help the dev workload more than the held-out ones.
sents.zh: 单独的智能体后续的改动大多是小幅参数调整（例如专家缓存逐出策略的半衰期），这些改动对开发工作负载的帮助大于对留出工作负载的帮助。

sents.en: The solo agent progressed more slowly and spent $200 in the 20 hours, while the team kept improving through $509 (decode lookahead hints, then exact multi-row verification enabling speculative decoding, then a larger victim cache), and its final engine is the fastest on every workload.
sents.zh: 单独的智能体进展较慢，在 20 小时内花费了 200 美元，而团队持续改进直至 509 美元（先是解码前瞻提示，然后是支持投机解码的精确多行验证，接着是更大的牺牲缓存），其最终引擎在所有工作负载上都是最快的。

sents.en: Measured together on the same Macs, it decodes at 30.3 30.3 tokens/s on the batch-1 decode benchmark, against 26.7 26.7 for the starting commit and 28.2 28.2 for the solo agent’s final engine.
sents.zh: 在相同的 Mac 上一起测量，它在 batch-1 解码基准上以 30.3 tokens/s 的速度解码，而起始提交为 26.7，单独智能体的最终引擎为 28.2。
